title: Tower Maze Defense (v17)
description: A tower defense maze game with seed-based map generation — enter or copy hex seeds to replay favorite layouts.
prompt: add a level seed text field, when a level is generated turn it into a hex string that can be reused to generate the same level. add a text box before the game has started displaying the level seed, make it so a user can input a level seed and have a little button next to it to load the map. do some basic check on it to make sure its a valid level seed, that the level is playable.
